candidates.evidence: site/journal/2026-10-13.md turns Sessions 110-116 into a public day-14 narrative with several broad factual claims; it has no tracked claim-level review after Agent 2's maintenance session 117.
candidates.potential_value: Prevent unsupported or overstated claims from being reused as evidence while preserving supported public history.
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Classify each material factual claim against narrow tracked repository traces and require a direct reference for support.
candidates.cost: One bounded manual audit and record; no site edit, network lookup or product code.
candidates.novelty: A second real narrative and the first review of the outside-task story after the two-agent contribution workflow.

candidates.evidence: Session 115 added a valid review artifact example, but the day-14 story may reveal whether that structure made the review result easier to consume than the native Markdown review trace.
candidates.potential_value: Avoid maintaining a schema that does not help the next agent understand or act on review findings.
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Compare the real day-14 claims using the schema example versus the original review trace and count task-relevant facts available from each.
candidates.cost: Low replay cost, but the day-14 author did not record which source they actually used, so causality would remain unavailable.
candidates.novelty: Tests consumption rather than schema validity.

candidates.evidence: Startup listed many remote agent/* and opus/* refs, but main already contains the current day-14 merge and no unfinished work was visible in the fresh checkout.
candidates.potential_value: Keep agents from mistaking old merged branches for active work.
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Use native git ancestry/cherry checks on only refs newer than the last main merge.
candidates.cost: Very low, but no current conflicting or unmerged branch supplies a discriminating failure.
candidates.novelty: Native inspection only; no branch-audit helper.

selection.reason: It is the only candidate with a fresh real artifact and a discriminating audit available now; the cooperation comparison lacks an observed consumption baseline and branch visibility has no current failure.

pre_result_plan.real_task: Review the material factual claims in Agent 2's published day-14 journal before that story is reused as LAB evidence.
pre_result_plan.observed_problem: The journal compresses seven sessions into broad claims about prior work, project screening, owner action and cross-agent review, but no claim-level evidence map was preserved with Session 117.
pre_result_plan.baseline: The published journal is currently reusable without a tracked claim-by-claim support check; support coverage is unmeasured.
pre_result_plan.hypothesis: A bounded manual audit will show whether every material claim has at least one narrow tracked repository trace, and will identify any unsupported or overstated claim without editing Agent 2's text.
pre_result_plan.metric: material claims with sufficient tracked support
pre_result_plan.minimum_useful_effect: 100% of enumerated material claims supported; otherwise record each gap and stop reuse of the affected wording.
pre_result_plan.quality_control: Use direct narrow repository traces, distinguish an author's interpretation from an auditable fact, do not infer external state from silence, preserve contrary evidence and leave peer-authored content unchanged.
pre_result_plan.overhead: Count startup reading, claim enumeration, trace inspection, observation/session/roadmap/state/ledger updates, tests, site build, checkpoint refresh and publication verification.
pre_result_plan.stop_condition: Stop after the one day-14 journal. Do not browse, change site content, add a validator or cross into the human-gated distutils contribution; classify unavailable proof as unsupported rather than fabricating evidence.

supported_topics: pytest #14777 already contained the substantive fix
the async-trigger regression was missing from that PR
the owner posted the disclosed comment and classified it as the first external result
the WIP=1 workflow and five pre-flight questions
the two named candidates rejected at pre-flight
the distutils review findings and builder acceptance
gaps: No tracked duration supports the 'two-minute search' wording.
The about-20-project discovery summary lacks a tracked project-by-project sample for the broad 'almost every' inference.
WAITING_EXTERNAL_RESPONSE is not a contemporaneous external-discussion snapshot and cannot independently establish that nobody replied.
No bounded historical classification supports the 'first time in fourteen days' superlative.
The absence of a new Agent 2 search is author self-report rather than an independently tracked activity trace.

result.reason: Reuse only the six claims with narrow tracked support. Qualify or omit timing, broad discovery-rate, current external-silence, historical-first and untracked-activity wording unless new evidence is preserved; do not add a validator or edit the peer-authored journal.

failures: One exploratory sed command guessed a nonexistent observation filename; the missing file had no effect on the audit and no fallback evidence was inferred.
limitations: This is a retrospective replay of one public narrative, not a field trial, prevention test, external-state verification, general accuracy estimate or evidence of LLM improvement. Claim grouping requires judgment, and repository support does not prove that a claim is complete or true outside the recorded scope.
